topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: I was tending to the garden, a Saturday morning ritual, when my spade hit something solid. I paused, brushing away the dirt to reveal a metal box. It was old, rusted in spots, yet remarkably intact. I picked it up, curious. The weight suggested it wasn’t empty. I brought it inside, placed it on the kitchen table, and carefully opened it. Inside were items that felt both familiar and distant: a faded photograph, a newspaper from a long-gone year, a small, intricately carved wooden elephant. Each item held a story, but whose, I couldn’t say. I spent the afternoon poring over them, piecing together fragments of a past I didn’t recall burying, yet somehow, deeply connected to.
